data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.secrets in module.github_actions_job_logs reads secret values but is not ordered after aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.cicd_secrets, so it may read before the version is seeded.

data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets in module.github_global_lock looks up the CI/CD secrets by name with no dependency on aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets, so on a first apply the read races ahead of secret creation and fails.

data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets in module.github_app_runner_group looks up the CI/CD secrets by name, but it has no ordering against aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets which creates them in the root module. On a fresh apply the lookup runs before the secret exists (Secrets Manager creation is eventually consistent), causing the read to fail. Add ordering to the secret resource.

data.aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.secrets in module.github_global_lock reads secret values with no ordering against aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.cicd_secrets, so it can run before the version is created/seeded.

Without this dependency the version read happens before the version is seeded.

data.aws_secretsmanager_secret.secrets in module.github_actions_job_logs looks up the CI/CD secrets by name without depending on aws_secretsmanager_secret.cicd_secrets; on a fresh apply the lookup can execute before the secret exists and fail.
